LESSON: DISINFECTING CLOTHING AND HOUSEHOLD ARTICLES

Grade: SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade 9
Subject: GRADE
Strand: Hygiene Practices
Topic 3.2: Disinfecting clothing and household articles
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 12

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Disinfecting clothing and household articles, part of Hygiene Practices in SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade 9 GRADE.

Key inquiry question: How can we disinfect household articles for hygiene purposes?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Disinfecting clothing and household articles together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
Learning to learn: Organizing own learning as they acquire new skills on methods of disinfecting clothing and household

articles.

Values:
Responsibility: Taking care of clothing and household articles as learners carry out disinfection.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
Health promotion awareness as learners disinfect clothing and household articles to prevent spread of diseases.

Links to other Learning Areas:
Learners relate use of disinfectants to solvents learnt in Integrated Science.
